title: Diagonale des Fous 2026 — parcours, barrières horaires et carte 3D
claims: The Reunion3D page presents the 2026 Diagonale des Fous as 180.6 km with +10,199 m D+ and a 66-hour limit.

The page states that the 2026 route removes the Cilaos cirque passage and the Col du Taïbit climb, going after Coteau Kerveguen to Caverne Dufour, Cap Anglais and the Bélouve gîte before entering the Salazie cirque.
The page states that Hell-Bourg replaces Cilaos as the first major base, with hot meal and drop bag.
The page offers a GPX download for the 2026 course from its course map.
Reunion3D is an independent third-party site, not the race organiser, and the page states no licence permitting redistribution of the GPX.
